mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.email, pr.legal_name, pr.nickname, u.active_type, at.activity_type_name AS active_type_name, u.user_type, ut.account_type_name AS user_type_name, pr.info_content, pr.external_link, pr.request_date, pr.approval_date FROM promotion_request pr INNER JOIN `user` u ON pr.information_provider_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN user_type ut ON ut.no = u.user_type INNER JOIN active_type at ON at.no = u.active_type WHERE pr.information_provider_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN pr.approval_date IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, -- 미승인 요청을 먼저 pr.request_date DESC -- 그 다음은 최신 순 LIMIT 1
